messages:
sara: quick note, saw a surge in fncall schema rejections in the canary cluster this morning. tool responses with extra top-level fields are getting rejected. example we logged:

 sara: ```json
 {"status":"ok","result":{"text":"done"},"trace_id":"abc123","_internal_metadata":{"latency_ms":12}}
 ```

 sara: validator message: `unexpected_properties: ['_internal_metadata']` — we return a structured reject which aborts the flow.

 max: are unknown props globally treated as hard-rejects now?

 kai: we flipped strict-by-default in the last validation rollout to catch tool bugs early. fncall had agreed to a gentler path though; looks like the per-route toggle wasn't applied to the canary tenant.

 liz: @kai can you confirm the tenant flag state?

 kai: logs show the tenant used the default (strict) policy.

 max: proposal: change behavior for unknown properties to soft-reject (log + metric + allow passthrough) for 14 days for existing customers, then enforce strict after notice. this reduces customer outages.

 liz: console needs more transparency: add reject_count and latest_sample to route pages so support can triage without paging infra.

 max: telemetry plan: emit `fncall.reject_rate_by_route`, `fncall.unknown_prop_softfail` and sampled `fncall.reject_examples` (sanitized). sampling rate: 1 example/minute/route.

 kai: must redact PII before storing samples. add ingestion redactor for fields that match common PII keys (email, ssn, credit_card, phone). also strip values > 1024 chars.

 sara: billing note: current hard-reject path refunds generation tokens but still charges a tool call. product wants clearer semantics. recommend: soft-fails should be non-billable for tools, hard rejects billed as now. needs product sign-off.

 max: two quick changes: 1) introduce route-level config `fncall.unknown_props_policy: strict|permissive|softfail`; 2) console toggle for account admins to flip policy and view guidance. default to permissive for legacy tenants, strict for new.

 liz: rollout plan: enable softfail FF in internal canaries, notify partners, provide migration docs and sample SDK shim to strip `_internal_*` props. after 30 days, schedule strict enforcement for accounts that haven't opted in.

 kai: I can add a short-term validator change to treat `unexpected_properties` as softfail when flag on: emit metric `fncall.unknown_prop_softfail` and continue. will open PR.

 sara: deploy-bot, please gate the change with a feature flag so we can rollback quickly if we see degeneration.

 deploy-bot: feature flag `fncall:unknown-props-softfail` created (ff-8812). default OFF in prod, ON in `canary-1` and `internal-dev`.

 max: ops: watch `fncall.reject_rate_by_route` and `fncall.unknown_prop_softfail`. if softfail >> rejects, may be masking real failures. set alert threshold if softfail > 10x rejects for 30m.

 liz: console updates: add stacked timeline showing rejects vs softfails vs passthroughs, plus a drilldown showing the sampled sanitized example and recommended remediation steps for tool authors.

 sara: SDK improvement: add an opt-in shim that strips fields starting with `_` or `internal` before validation to avoid partners having to change immediately. low-risk and reversible.

 kai: will include SDK shim in the PR and mark it opt-in.

 max: action items: kai PR for validator softfail + metrics + SDK shim; liz console widget + docs; product to confirm billing semantics; ops to add alerts and monitor. rollout: enable ff in more canaries tomorrow, monitor 48h, then widen.

 sara: any objections?

 liz: +1

 max: :thumbsup:

 kai: on it

 deploy-bot: deployment scheduled 2026-04-03T02:00:00Z to canary clusters.
